code.basis: repository LICENSE header; not a weights/data license

name: Index
notes: GitHub reports the repository as archived, with the last push on 2025-06-09. The tree holds the agent, Playwright browser and controller modules (actions include give_human_control and spreadsheet-cell clicks), providers for Anthropic, Bedrock, Gemini, Vertex, OpenAI and Groq, and two structured-output eval scripts rather than a benchmark. The README also advertises a hosted serverless Index API and chat UI run by Laminar; their current availability was not checked. Apache-2.0 covers repository code only.
summary: Archived Laminar browser agent in Python that drives Playwright Chromium with vision-capable LLMs, returns Pydantic-structured results and offers an interactive CLI with optional Laminar tracing.
